name: Marrickville Many May Open 2023
information:
This competition is a **series competition** 

[Marrickville Many May Open 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MarrickvilleManyMayOpen2023) - Saturday Whole Day, May 20, 2023 
[Marrickville Mini May Open 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MarrickvilleMiniMayOpen2023) - Sunday Morning, May 21, 2023
[Marrickville Mega May Open 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MarrickvilleMegaMayOpen2023) - Sunday Afternoon - May 21, 2023

You may only compete in **ONE** of the three Marickville May competitions. Note that each competition has slightly different events.
